multifit command line interface

Usage:

multifit [–version] [–copying] [–help] COMMAND [ARGS…]

Options:
-h, --help

Print the help screen for the given command and exit.

--version

Print version number and exit.

--copying

Print copyright notice and exit.

List of commands:
config:

Generate a new config file.

fit:

Fit a set of spectra.

gate:

Run a GUI for gating on coincidence spectra.

plot:

Plot a set of spectra, optionally including a fit result.

See multifit help COMMAND for more information on a specific command.

Command config

Generate a multifit configuration file.

Usage: multifit config

-h, --help

Print this help screen and exit.

Copyright (C) 2026 Johannes Sørby Heines

Command plot

Plot a dataset and (optionally) a fit result.

Usage:

multifit plot CONFIG [LOG] [–color MAP [–import MODULE]] [–xlabel LABEL] [–ylabel LABEL] [–callnumber N] [–background INDEX] [–no-normalize]

Positional arguments:
CONFIG:

yaml configuration file.

LOG:

json log file generated by multifit fit.

Options:
-h, --help

Print this help screen and exit.

-x, --xlabel LABEL

Label on the x axis. [default: value]

-y, --ylabel LABEL

Label on the y axis. [default: counts per bin]

-c, --color MAP

Name of the colormap to use. [default: viridis]

-i, --import MODULE

Use a third party colormap from MODULE.

--no-normalize

Don’t nomralize the histogram.

Fit selection options (only relevant if LOG is provided):
--callnumber N

Number of the migrad iteration to plot. Starts at 1, supports reverse indexing. [default: -1]

-b, --background INDEX

Use this component of the model cdf as the background when plotting.

Copyright (C) 2026 Johannes Sørby Heines

Command fit

Fit a density to multiple histograms simulatneously.

Usage:

multifit fit CONFIG LOG [-v] [-r | -a] [–minos PARAM…] [options]

Positional arguments:
CONFIG:

yaml configuration file.

LOG:

json log file. By default, raises an error if the file already exists.

Options:
-h, --help

Show this help screen and exit.

-v, --verbose

Print runtime information.

-r, --recreate

Replace an existing log file.

-a, --append

Append to an existing log file.

--tries N

Number of times to run the migrad minimiser before giving up. [default: 5]

--strategy N

Strategy to use for the minimisation. Choices are 0 (fast), 1, 2 (careful). See the iminuit documentation for details. [default: 1]

–minos PARAM… Calculate minos errors for the given parameters,

or use ‘all’ for all parameters (not usually necessary). This can take several minutes.

--retries N

Rerun migrad this number of times after a minimum has been found. [default: 0]

--no-delete

Keep the log file after an exception. The state of this file is undefined.

Copyright (C) 2026 Johannes Sørby Heines

Usage:

multifit gate CONFIG [options]

General options:
-h, --help

Print this help screen and exit.

-e, --export PATH

Export location for gated spectra. If not given, uses the location of the data files. This can be changed before each export.

Plotting options:
-c, --color MAP

Name of the colormap to use. [default: cmc.lajolla_r]

-x, --xlabel LABEL

Label for the x axis. [default: value]

-y, --ylabel LABEL

Label for the y axis. [default: counts per bin]

-g, --gridsep VALUE

Fixed separation of the gridlines on the y axis.

Debugging options:
--printargs

Print arguments and exit.
